solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Young bird, showy and argumentative

parts.note: a squab is a young pigeon not yet fledged
bling is flashy, ostentatious jewellery or display, used here as an adjective

explanation.surface: A description of a fledgling that is both flashy and quarrelsome.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone bickering noisily over trivia is being argumentative, so the participle stands in as an adjective.

clue.text: Put together broadcast — broadcast news broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of the word after it are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A broadcast assembled from news, with the word repeated for effect.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue offers more than one route: 'broadcast news' (or 'news broadcast') rearranges NEWS, and 'broadcast — broadcast' also gives a word sounding like SOWN, as seed is broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: Stitched with needle and thread, pieces of fabric are joined into one.

clue.text: Relatively courteous Pope's hesitant expression

parts.note: Urban is the name of eight popes
er is the sound of someone hesitating

explanation.surface: A pontiff whose manner is polite, though he hesitates in speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Urbane means suave and polite; the comparative form means more so, hence relatively courteous.

clue.text: Act as a friend and place undergarment over uncovered belly, that'll prevent sunburn

parts.note: to be a chum is to act as a friend

indicators.note: over says the garment is placed covering the next piece, so it goes around it

parts.note: a bra is a woman's undergarment

indicators.note: uncovered strips the outer letters from the word

explanation.surface: Advice on modesty at the seaside: be friendly and cover your midriff to avoid burning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uncovered' strips the outer letters of the stomach word; 'over' wraps the garment round them. The definition is a whole phrase describing the object's purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: A large parasol stuck in the sand shades sunbathers from the sun's rays.

clue.text: Allow rises in stake as a recent thing

indicators.note: in places the reversed word inside the stake

parts.note: to lay money is to stake it as a bet

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means reading from bottom to top, so the word is reversed

parts.note: to let is to allow

explanation.surface: A gambler permitting raised bets, which is a new development.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rises' gives TEL as this is a down clue; 'in' sets it inside the bet. The definition is an adverbial phrase, matching the adverb.
explanation.definitionFit: Something happening of late has happened recently, a recent occurrence.

clue.text: Desperately seek a man, e.g. one from Five Guys Named Moe?

definitions.text: e.g. one from Five Guys Named Moe?

indicators.note: desperately suggests frantic disorder, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A lonely-hearts plea: hunting for a man, perhaps one of the Five Guys Named Moe.
explanation.walkthrough: Five Guys Named Moe is a Louis Jordan song and stage musical; each Moe shares a name with the others.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone bearing the same name as another, as each Moe does, is that person's namesake.

clue.text: Cast out random syllables

indicators.note: out can mean wrong or inaccurate, so the letters of the word before it are put out of order

explanation.surface: An instruction to throw away meaningless sounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cast out' reads as one phrasal verb meaning expel, but 'out' is the signal to rearrange 'Cast'.
explanation.definitionFit: Scat is the jazz singing style built from improvised nonsense syllables in place of words.

clue.text: Rubbish coal fire, failing to start, produces small amount of heat

indicators.note: rubbish describes something poor, and as a signal says the letters are messed up
failing to start means the word loses its first letter

explanation.surface: A poor coal fire that won't light gives off little warmth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'failing to start' drops F from FIRE, leaving IRE; 'Rubbish' rearranges COAL plus IRE.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit of energy, defined by the heat needed to warm a gram of water by one degree.

clue.text: Major, abandoning queen, was a turncoat? Flipping nonsense

indicators.note: flipping turns the whole assembled string over, so it is read backwards
abandoning says the queen is dropped from the word

parts.note: major can mean elder, as Smith major is the older brother
ER is the Queen's cipher, Elizabeth Regina
did a rat means behaved like a rat, deserting one's side

explanation.surface: A disgraced officer accused of treachery, with a mild expletive of disbelief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoning' takes ER from ELDER, leaving ELD; with DID A RAT that makes ELDDIDARAT, which 'Flipping' reverses. 'Flipping' looks like a mild British swear word.
explanation.definitionFit: A taradiddle is a petty lie or pretentious nonsense, an old-fashioned word.

clue.text: Programme on computer arranging cabs when raining outside

indicators.note: outside says the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: when it is raining the weather is wet

indicators.note: arranging puts the letters of the following word into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone sorting out taxis on a rainy day while a show plays online.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranging' signals the anagram of the taxis, and 'outside' sets the rainy word around it; 'when' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A webcast is a broadcast transmitted over the internet and watched on a computer.

clue.text: One tampering with report on successful athlete?

indicators.note: a report is something heard, so the clue asks for a word that sounds like the athlete

parts.note: an athlete who wins a medal is a medaller

explanation.surface: A doping scandal: someone interfering with the paperwork about a winning athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: A busybody who interferes in matters that are not their concern is tampering with them.

clue.text: Doctor aiding actions abroad

indicators.note: abroad means widely scattered, so the letters are spread about

explanation.surface: A medic helping out with operations overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' tempts as the anagram signal, but it is the definition and 'abroad' does the rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: A physician who identifies illnesses from symptoms is a specialist in diagnosis.

clue.text: Anything Goes put on in Japanese theatre captivates poet

parts.note: No (also spelt Noh) is classical Japanese masked drama
to captivate an audience is to hold it

indicators.note: put, paired with the later in, tells us to place one piece inside another
in, after put, says the word for on goes inside the word for poet

parts.note: a bard is a poet
re means on or concerning, as in a memo heading

explanation.surface: Cole Porter's musical Anything Goes being staged at a Noh theatre, enthralling a poet.
explanation.definitionFit: A contest with no restrictions at all is one where anything is allowed, the phrase coming from wrestling rules.

clue.text: Examine clubs in ruined sites journalist's avoided after bombing

indicators.note: after a bombing things are blown apart, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for the card suit clubs

indicators.note: avoided says those letters are left out

parts.note: ED, short for editor, is the usual journalist; the 's is just is

explanation.surface: Inspecting nightclubs among sites wrecked by an explosion, which a reporter has kept away from.
explanation.walkthrough: 'avoided' takes ED out of RUINED SITES, leaving RUINSITES; 'after bombing' rearranges that with C.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrutinise something is to inspect it closely and critically.

clue.text: Colourful element in church, Catholic one

parts.note: Rome stands for the Roman Catholic Church as a whole

explanation.surface: Pointing out a brightly coloured feature inside a Catholic church.
explanation.definitionFit: Chromium takes its name from Greek chroma, colour, because its compounds are so vividly coloured.

clue.text: He's a kind, playful youth with not much up top?

definitions.text: youth with not much up top?

indicators.note: playful suggests the letters are frolicking about into a new order

explanation.surface: Describing a friendly, jokey young man who happens to be bald or dim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playful' rearranges the letters of 'He's a kind'. 'Not much up top' suggests either a shaved head or a lack of brains.
explanation.definitionFit: A youth of the cropped-head subculture has very little hair, hence not much on the head.

clue.text: Congratulations left to victor at the end of intricate puzzle

indicators.note: at the end of places the victor's letter after the rest

parts.note: a maze is a puzzle of winding paths
V is Victor in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Praise for a winner who has solved a fiendish puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: Mazel tov is the Hebrew and Yiddish expression for good luck, used to wish someone well.

clue.text: Increase power when crossing river in this direction?

parts.note: to up a price is to increase it

indicators.note: the river is crossed by the power, so R sits inside it

parts.note: steam power drove engines

explanation.surface: Boosting engine power to get across a river, against the current.
explanation.walkthrough: A semi-all-in-one: going upriver needs more power, which the wordplay describes.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving against the current, towards a river's source, is travelling that way.

clue.text: Leader's wrestling holds before

indicators.note: holds says the first piece contains the second

parts.note: sumo is Japanese wrestling
pre is a prefix meaning before

explanation.surface: A wrestling champion's grips are listed before a bout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holds' looks like wrestling grips, but signals containment.
explanation.definitionFit: A supremo is the person in overall charge, the boss.

clue.text: Attack, losing head in old-timers' drinking bout

indicators.note: losing its head means the word drops its first letter

parts.note: wassail is an old word for a festive drinking session

explanation.surface: An assault taking place during a boozy session among elderly people.
explanation.definitionFit: To assail someone is to attack them, physically or with criticism.

clue.text: Chinese captured by US soldier supporting a fellow Asian

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits below, so it comes after
captured by says the first piece is held inside the second

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier
the Han are China's majority ethnic group

explanation.surface: A Chinese man taken prisoner by an American soldier who is backing another Asian.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Afghanistan is an Asian person; the word also names its currency.

clue.text: Did project recalling some of last words after Julius (the lead character) died

indicators.note: after puts these pieces behind the initial
the lead character is the first letter of the name
recalling means calling back, so those words are read backwards

parts.note: Et tu, Brute were Caesar's reputed last words; et tu is part of them

explanation.surface: A theatre production of Julius Caesar quoting his dying line before the lead actor died.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that stuck out or protruded has projected.

clue.text: This person's acquiring beans, doing as Jack did with magic ones?

definitions.text: doing as Jack did with magic ones?

parts.note: this person is the speaker, so I'm
pulses are edible seeds such as beans and lentils
buying is acquiring by purchase

explanation.surface: Someone announcing they are getting hold of beans, like Jack and the Beanstalk.
explanation.walkthrough: Split 3,5,6 the answer reads as the speaker announcing a bean purchase. Jack swapped the family cow for magic beans on a whim.
explanation.definitionFit: Jack bought the magic beans on a sudden whim, a spontaneous unplanned purchase.

clue.text: Spoken for, a lover hides

indicators.note: hides says the answer is concealed within the words before it

explanation.surface: Someone already taken, with a secret lover concealed.
explanation.definitionFit: An oral agreement is spoken rather than written.

clue.text: Part of former band's vague

parts.note: to be in a group is to be part of it
ex means former
a band is a musical act; the 's is just is

explanation.surface: Someone in a defunct pop group being described as imprecise.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 2,2,3, the answer says someone belonged to a band that has split.
explanation.definitionFit: Something imprecise or not exact is vague.

clue.text: Poor Melody, where d'you disappear to?

parts.note: thin means poor or meagre
an air is a tune or melody

explanation.surface: A lament for a lost tune, or for someone called Melody who has vanished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Melody' looks like a woman's name addressed in the question.
explanation.definitionFit: People who vanish without trace are said to have disappeared into it, in the idiom.

clue.text: Former object of worship hurt after rejection

indicators.note: rejection turns the word back, so it is read backwards

parts.note: sore means hurt or painful

explanation.surface: Someone who once idolised another feels wounded after being spurned.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek god of love was worshipped in ancient times, hence a former deity.

clue.text: Tending to prove reckless, dive in late

indicators.note: reckless implies wild, uncontrolled movement, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A footballer's late, careless sliding tackle proving the case against them.
explanation.definitionFit: Material that serves as evidence helps prove a point, so it is of that nature.
